title: Knot_Island
lead_summary:
Knot Island, also known as One Island,  is a town that be accessed from the East by Kindle Road and from the South by Treasure Beach.
In the PokéCenter, Bebe and a scientist are looking for a Network Adapter they lost, which can be found in Kindle Road. After helping them, Bebe will give the player the Box Link.

items.name: Heart Scale
items.location_details: On shallow water between the beach and the ferry dock.

items.name: Heart Scale
items.location_details: Hidden in a box south of the Triple Battle Lounge.

items.name: Box Link
items.location_details: Given by Bebe in the Pokémon Center after giving her the Network Adapter.

items.name: Nugget
items.location_details: Exchange 1 Heart Scale in the Pokémon Center.

items.name: Diamond Necklace
items.location_details: Exchange 1 Diamond, 3 Pearls, 1 Escape Rope and ₽25,000.
